label: Throughput Test
info:
Measures end-to-end throughput with per-stage breakdown.

Each message carries a birth timestamp through the full pipeline:
inject → generator → event-in → cache → calc → counter

Reports: total time, msg/sec, and per-message avg latency.

Results show: generator speed, event-in passthru speed, simple calc speed, complex calc speed
info:
Compare the rates to see where time is spent.
Generator = raw message creation
Pass-thru = event-in + cache write only
Simple = cache write + simple expression
Complex = cache write + expression with hasChanged/prev lookups
